Results.ReviewText: Disappointed. No air flow indicator for bottom vents. Made my own with a marks-a-lot. Lid does not fully retract out of the way. Better to just take it off. Temp gauge is placed on the side where your hot coals would be causing an inaccurate temp. You want your temp gauge on the opposite side where the heat would be flowing over your meat and out the exhaust vent on the other side.

Results.ReviewText:
The deep ocean blue color is beautiful, and the grill holds charcoal as I would expect. The included grate it turns out, is really a pain to deal with as the center insert constantly moves around (really annoying when cleaning). I'd prefer a heavy grate with larger hinged areas for adding charcoal (I read the premium kettle grade is lighter).  I also found the warming rack to be of dubious value as it blocks the hinges and is mostly just in the way... I'm not using it. Perhaps it will be valuable for some later use.
 
When I was flattening the shipping box there were a couple large paint chips on the bottom. Inspecting the (already assembled) grill, it looked like the paint had come off from the area outside when the legs attach. This made sense to me, as I had to use oil and a lot of (twisting) force to get the legs inserted (metal shave off the legs in the process) - I looked to me like there was excess paint buildup inside the leg holes so it makes sense it was excessive on the outside causing it to flake.

In all, I'd say I like it, but with reservations. I'm hopeful the paint issue will not cause further problems. I might recommend the lower-cost model instead to someone making a purchase.
Results.Title: Good, but not great.

Results.ReviewText: It was very hard to attach the legs to my grill, and I had to force them in. When I was almost finished putting it together, I noticed that the grill was missing the screw needed to attach the protective handle to the base (instead there was an extra part for the wheels), so I found a screw myself, but then I saw that the screw hole is halfway covered. So after all the difficulty of putting it together, I can't use it without the protective handle. I have sent several emails and called twice, only to wait on hold for 20-25 minutes and then give up. I got a customer service rep once, and he put me on hold, and then after 20 minutes the call dropped, and no one called me back. I know we all need to be patient now, but it's a real bummer to spend $250 on a defective product and not be able to get a replacement.
Results.Title: Defective grill -- and no response from Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is a high quality charcoal grill!!  We've only used it three times so far.  First time was bad because it was so windy & rained so bad it basically turned off..  That was for marinated chicken ~ ended up finishing in the oven.  Second time was for burgers ~ turned out great..  Third time was for hot dogs ~ don't leave your hot dogs over direct heat for very long.. Learning once again to become the master chefs of the charcoal grill :)  The last time I left the lid open & the coals ignited much better.   I will totally recommend this product!!  The only thing that it's missing is sides to set your plates or trays on, which you can get with Weber's higher end grills.  Love it & will be enjoying it for many years..
Results.Title: This is a high quality charcoal grill..

Results.ReviewText:
I am extremely pleased with the quality and performance of my Weber grill. It is truly becoming a way of life. It makes grilling more scientific yet also an enjoyable art. I can mix direct and indirect grilling with one cook, for various periods of time...controlling for temperature well enough.

I highly recommend this excellent family of products.
Results.Title: Loving My Weber

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased a Master-Touch after deciding to upgrade from an old Weber 18" Kettle that was passed down to me by my grandfather. I have been impressed with how well this grill handles everything I have thrown at it. So far I have smoked three turkeys, two chickens, one pork butt, in addition to making dozens of wood-fired pizzas using a ceramic pizza stone, grilled chicken, vegetables, burgers, steaks, and so much more. Whether you are grilling or smoking over direct or indirect heat, temperature control is something you will not have to worry about. The size of this grill allows for almost anything to be cooked on it without problems, and the deep ash catcher keeps you grilling without needing to spend too much time disposing of spent charcoal or wood. I have not had a chance to test out any of the Weber products that fit in the center of the grill grate, but I hope to start building a collection of accessories soon. I also purchased a cover for this grill and if it lasts as long as my grandfather's grill, I'll hope to be using this grill for 20+ years.
Results.Title: Master-Touch makes Master-Grillers

Results.ReviewText: The only thing that held me back from giving it 5 stars is a huge one. Doesn’t seem to be sturdy. I’m used to cleaning my 5k offset smoker and 3k gas Grill and get down a dirty with them after each cook to avoid rust and extend longevity. I really had to back off on cleaning if because it was flopping side to side I felt like it was going to fall apart. Since it’s been purchased and the value has depreciated i May consider drill and installing some fasteners on the legs to get some stability.

Even better, another one of my daughters has learned to start it up and they are both learning to do the grilling.  This may end up better than I ever imagined!

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
